plain_english_policy: Encourage private-sector hiring of welfare recipients via tax breaks for employers.

effects.rationale: Tax incentives disproportionately benefit businesses, not welfare recipients directly.
Reduces reliance on public assistance by shifting responsibility to employers.
Relies on private-sector delivery of welfare-related services (employment).
Empowers employers to hire from welfare rolls, aligning with capital interests.

evidence_quote: "Provide tax incentives to businesses that hire welfare recipients"
